text: Based on the NASA FIRMS data analysis for the period of 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-25, there were no fire detections intersecting the asset (ASSET-F02). The evaluation covered data from VIIRS (S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) and MODIS sensors, with full coverage from 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24 and partial coverage on the last day (2026-10-25). The zero detections indicate no fire activity was observed on or near the asset during the evaluated period.
